summary: Luján voted against tabling a resolution requiring a State Department report on US weapons use in Gaza, and in April 2026 voted for two Sanders resolutions blocking arms sales, calling the Netanyahu government's war 'illegal.' He co-signed a letter to CENTCOM questioning whether US forces supported Israel's forced displacement in Lebanon. His 2024 letter supporting hostage diplomacy and a mutual ceasefire, and his October 2026 post commemorating October 7 victims, reflect a more measured diplomatic framing alongside those votes.
